title: Late Funding History and the Paystride Payroll Card Program Restoration Reserve
content:
For a Paystride Payroll Card Program, the restoration reserve — the reserve a restoring payment brings the funding balance up to — is multiplied for late funding, counting the late funding fees debited in the restoration look-back less the late funding fees credited in it:

| Late funding fees debited in the look-back, less those credited in it | Multiplier of the restoration reserve |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.2 |
| exactly one | 1.1 |
| none | none — the reserve is not multiplied for late funding |

**The look-back.** The fees and credits counted are those dated in the restoration look-back holding the funding entries dated today or earlier that lie fewer than three whole months before today, the whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's. A late funding fee and a credit of a late funding fee each count by their own entry date.

**Net counting.** Two late funding fees debited and one late funding fee credited, all in the look-back, count as exactly one.

### Hypothetical cases

| Late funding fees debited | Late funding fees credited | Net | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 1.2 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 1.1 |
| 1 | 1 | none | none |

A restoration reserve figure of 2,050.00 multiplied by 1.2 is 2,460.00, and by 1.1 is 2,255.00.
